verdict.rationale: Docs say Bugbot automatically re-reviews on every PR update. They also say it reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback, which covers the 're-review without repeating old comments' core. Nothing documents explicitly tracking or marking which earlier findings were fixed, or limiting the review to new commits. One community report also describes a reviewer (Bugbot or Claude) arguing against an already-implemented fix, though it is ambiguous which tool did it. Missing for 10: explicit fixed-issue tracking or auto-resolution of addressed comments, documented incremental diff-only review on new commits, independent hands-on corroboration of the deduplication behavior.
